description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee membership search results within the HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods related to employee number filtering and sorting.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters for employee membership searches, including sorting and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field to 'm.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number as an integer or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
